r13.exp: 'Bullied for being such a scraggy little thing, she started training NOT TO BE PUSHED AROUND' = njezina tjelesna veličina bila je razlog maltretiranja = A (Her size).

r14.exp: 'The amazing thing about Sandra is that IT DIDN'T APPEAR TO AFFECT HER' = nije je uznemirivalo = D (It didn't bother her).

r15.exp: 'It has JUSTIFIED the many years of hard training' = osjećaj da su godine truda bile vrijedne = D (Justified).

r16.exp: 'I had proved TO MYSELF that I was the best in the world. Made all years of SELF-SACRIFICE worthwhile.' = za sebe = D.

r17.exp: 'CONSTANT ARGUMENTS WITH MY TRAINER... closest I got to WALKING OUT ON EVERYTHING' = problemi s trenerom = D.

r18.exp: 'Grim determination that I've INHERITED FROM MY FATHER' = mentalnu snagu pripisuje ocu = A.

r19.exp: 'Making paper aeroplanes like schoolboys. (19)___. They're not fooling around — studying physics.' → G: The only difference is that these boys are being given design tips by a computer.

r20.exp: 'Head towards the learning resource centre. (20)___. They find Jane hunting through The Times.' → E: Here they can borrow books, do last-minute homework or sit at the computers.

r21.exp: 'Ian used email to get the latest from Greenpeace. (21)___. Computers are permanently online.' → F: There's no other way they could have got such up-to-date information.

r22.exp: 'Nothing new about new technology. (22)___. They have used them in primary school and at home.' → C: There have been computers around for as long as they can remember.

r23.exp: 'Jonathan uses computer for artwork. (23)___. Sarah: algebra/biology programme explains again and again.' → D: Nevertheless, students appreciate things the computer can help them do. Prijelaz na akademsku korist.

r24.exp: 'Takes chore out of homework. (24)___. Pia: can't ask computer questions, it just asks you them.' → B: However, most students do not think that computers will ever replace teachers.

r25.exp: 'DESPITE the best of intentions' — 'despite' + imenička skupina (bez prijedloga, uz razliku od 'in spite of').

r26.exp: 'Nothing to DO with a lack of willpower' — fiksna kolokacija: have nothing to do with = nemati veze s.

r27.exp: 'When a diet comes to AN END' — fiksna kolokacija: come to an end = završiti.

r28.exp: 'TO BE PRECISE, they need to eat at least 300 fewer calories' — 'to be precise' = konkretiziranje/preciziranje podatka koji je prethodno naveden.

r29.exp: 'Over the COURSE of a week' — fiksna kolokacija: over the course of = u tijeku (vremenskog perioda).

r30.exp: 'Someone ELSE of a similar weight' — 'someone else' = netko drugi (neodređena zamjenica).

r31.exp: 'Play A role' — fiksna kolokacija: play a role = igrati ulogu (neodređeni član uz role).

r32.exp: 'Areas are more active, WHILE those that generate restraint are less so' — 'while' za kontrast/suprotnost između dviju surečenica.

r33.exp: 'But HAD/GOT his hours cut' — 'had his hours cut' (have sth done) ili 'got his hours cut' (got sth done). Passivna kauzativna konstrukcija.

r34.exp: 'A job with evening hours SO he can go back to school' — 'so (that)' za svrhu: so he can... = kako bi mogao...

r35.exp: 'Hasn't been ABLE to find either' — fiksna konstrukcija: be able to = moći, biti u mogućnosti.

r36.exp: 'Key EMPLOYERS of young workers' — 'employer' = poslodavac; ovi sektori su ključni poslodavci mladih.

r37.exp: 'Unemployment RATE' — fiksna kolokacija: unemployment rate = stopa nezaposlenosti.

r38.exp: 'Make UP just 3.2%' — frazalni glagol: make up = čine, sačinjavaju (postotak, udio).

r39.exp: 'Rose BY about 7%' — prijedlog 'by' za promjenu (povećanje/smanjenje) za određeni iznos.

r40.exp: 'In CONTRAST, headed in the other direction' — fiksni izraz: in contrast = nasuprot tome, za razliku.
